Welcome to the Divoom API

    
##### command description

- it will set the device brightness. 

| Head  |Len   |Cmd   |Bright   |Checksum   |Tail   |
| :------------: | :------------: | :------------: | :------------: | :------------: | :------------: |
|0x01   |xx (2 bytes)   |0x74   |0~100   |xx   |0x02   |
Bright: One byte representing the system brightness, ranging from 0 to 100.
